verdicts.reason: True: F-2-16 has no in-edges. False: "the tool can never show" it. The current-visa picker in visamap.js offers every non-goal code, F-2-16 included. Started on F-2-16, the engine lists F-5-28 and F-5-29 (reproduced). The fix is wrong. F-2-16 has no list in data/visadocs.yaml, so new edges from E-1/E-3/E-7-1/F-2-99 would fail the data test "a move inside Korea goes to a visa the manual lets you change to there", and an edge from NONE would fail the "from abroad" test. Offering a discretionary Ministry grant (카목) as a next step from ordinary work statuses would also mislead. Deleting the nodes would drop real holders' PR route. tests/data.test.mjs already reads a `startOnly` list for exactly this case. Seeding its reachability walk with the start-only codes clears F-2-16, F-5-28 and F-5-29 (checked with node).

verdicts.reason: The finding itself says the K-STAR chapter of the 2026.9.18 manual must be checked. Its transcription in data/visadocs.yaml settles it. The K-STAR 거주(F-2-7S) lists in chapter 41 (graduates, integrated MS-PhD students, PhD-coursework completers, postdocs; change and extension) ask for the university president's recommendation and a degree or enrolment certificate. They ask for no points table. The chapter 30 points-based list for 잠재적 우수인재 does require 점수표【붙임 2】 and its proofs【붙임 3】. So the K-STAR track that F-2-7S's `how` describes ("K-STAR university … president's recommendation") is granted without the 80-point test. The K-STAR universities are also wider than 2025-408's 붙임 1: the list names the Korea Univ. Sejong, Yonsei Mirae and Hanyang ERICA campuses, so F-2-7S is not just group ⑤. "Points waived" is accurate; the proposed rewording would be wrong.
